design.reserve: LP only: LpSetup.fill_facility calls LpReserve7.seed(w,F). It spawns 100 Sentinels straight into the Sentinel Barracks (Garrison.place_inside, Sentinels7.enlist, job k=rest j=lpr:in bid=barracks). Type mix = rules.g7_sentinels.start.force proportions without the bearer (largest remainder): warden 30, marksman 17, gunner 13, lancer 13, bulwark 9, arc 9, mender 9. Last stand = 20 (same proportions), group 'l'; the rest group 'r'. Start garrison (24, seeded by Sentinels7 a few ticks later) is untouched.
design.barracks_cap: LP barracks entity gets b.g7_xs = 20 -> Garrison.cap_of(b) = 140 (new helper; free_slots uses it). At LP start: 103-ish occupants / 140 (100 reserve + off-duty roster), >= 20 free. Skirmish barracks has no g7_xs (120).
design.board_exclusion: sentinels7.gd _role: a member of sys_state.lpres7.m is never planned on the facility job board (3 lines). Released men run the normal Sentinels7 drills through their job records.
tiers (every 1 s per facility, staggered: pressure from Sentinels7._net (guard net, only while Sentinels7.threat is up): weight clamp(max_hp/100, 0.5, 8) per enemy, by face n/e/s/w, 'in' (inside compound grown -1), 'core' (core_rect [2,2,11,15] + 3, compound-local)

1 POSTS: roster snapshot (owner's non-member, non-bearer Sentinels with job fac == fac or -1); ones gone since the last step queue their type in Rr.need; up to 2 per step a fit reserve man (same type first) is handed to the board (job auto, S.call = true)

2 QRF: face pressure >= 6 and cd 12 s: need = ceil(p*1.0) - men already there; squad clamp(need,4,8); job k=standto (Sentinels7 bound/cover/settle/withdraw drill) with 'hand' so Sentinels7 walks him out of the barracks; goals on the wall-walk (n [x,1], e [27,y], w [1,y], slid to the attackers' centre) or the gate staging yard (s [14,18.5]); pairs 2.5 apart; buddy pairs (bud) set

3 SURGE: inside pressure >= 2 (or breached + any): need = ceil(p_in*2) - committed, min 12 for the first; job k=qrf bid=barracks (Sentinels7 QRF turn-out pair by pair, close with the deepest intruder); cd 10 s
LAST STAND: only when core pressure > 0: all fit 'l' men in the barracks -> standto at core points [[4.5,7.5],[12.5,10.5],[12.5,14.5],[6.5,12.5]]

recall: auto squads come home (job rest, M.st ret) when their face / in / core had no pressure for quiet_s 20 (and squad age >= 20 s); manual squads only by RECALL. Withdrawn (job auto) or player-timeout members are sent home; back inside -> st in, ammo refilled
barracks lost: 'r' members handed to the board, 'l' members commit to the core for good; trickle stops

trickle: every 45 s while members < 100 and the barracks has room: type furthest below its share, paid at the production cost x1.0 (w.spend), spawned into the barracks; 'l' first while the last stand is short
design.commands: lpres_release {building_id?, count?} (squad of manual_n 6 to the most pressed face, else the gate), lpres_recall (everyone out home + auto QRF held recall_hold_s 20 s), lpres_auto {on}. Validated: issuer owns the reserve, barracks alive, someone ready / out.
